people.name: Ms. Shubhlakshmi Dani
people.evidence_quote: have unanimously approved the appointment of Ms. Shubhlakshmi Dani (DIN: 02942138) as an Additional and Non-Executive Director of the Company, with immediate effect.
people.tenure_quote: Her appointment as a Non – Executive Director, liable to retire by rotation, shall be subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company.
people.bio_quote: Shubhlakshmi Dani is the Whole-time Director of Shubhit Holdings Private Limited (‘Shubhit’), an RBI -registered Non- Banking Financial Company, guided by an investment philosophy focused on preserving wealth across generations. At Shubhit she is responsible for governance, strategic planning, operations, compliance and investment oversight. She is also the co-founder of Life is Beautiful, a home and lifestyle brand dedicated to offering thoughtfully curated products made in India.
